source.question: When was well F-11 B completed, and how does its completion report's timing compare with when it started producing?

submission.summary: Well F-11 B was completed and handed over in July 2013 with first oil on 2013-07-24, and the Final Well Report Completion is Valid from 2013-09-04, about 42 days after first oil.

findings.claim: Final Well Report shows Well F-11 B completion sequence included Run Completion, Install Tubing Hanger, Install X-mas Tree, Perforation and Handover activities in late June to July 2013.
Well F-11 first oil was on 2013-07-24 with 8 producing days in that partial July 2013 month, and daily records confirm first non-zero oil on 2013-07-24.
The Final Well Report, Completion, 15/9-F-11 B is dated Valid from 2013-09-04 on both its header and table-of-contents pages.
Handover to first oil was 2 days, Run Completion to first oil was 24 days, and the final report followed first oil by 42 days.
